description: This Java class provides functionality for deep cloning objects via serialization. It primarily includes a method to create deep copies of serializable objects, utilizing byte streams, and a utility method to close streams safely.

classes.name: ObjectCloner
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for deep copying serializable objects and safely closing closeable resources.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a given serializable object by serializing and deserializing it.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Safely closes a Closeable resource, ignoring any IOException.
